name: claude-code-logos
description: Plugins that manage how Claude Code runs — how skills are written, which model and effort to use, where documentation answers come from, which deletions and edits under archive folders are refused. Each states the evidence it rests on.

plugins.name: skill-best-practices
plugins.description: Evidence-based practices for writing better Claude Code skills — 8 practices from cognitive science with before/after examples, plus hooks that deliver the rules at runtime

plugins.name: model-effort
plugins.description: Choose the Claude model and effort level for each situation — session, subagents, Workflow agents, skill frontmatter, API scripts — with Claude Code and API defaults kept apart and every recommendation tagged with its source

plugins.name: livedocs
plugins.description: Answer questions about a library, SDK or CLI from its primary source, read live — llms.txt, package registry, repository, OpenAPI/GraphQL, CLI introspection — through an MCP server and a look-up skill. macOS only; the plugin downloads its MCP server binary from GitHub Releases

plugins.name: archive-first
plugins.description: Hooks that refuse a Bash rm, rmdir or unlink whose command text names a path under archive/ or archived/, and refuse the Write and Edit tools on files under those directories; a command that copies a folder there before it is reorganised. Other ways of changing those files through Bash are not refused. The hooks need jq and allow everything without it
